label: Cosmogony
notes: Narrative explaining the origin and development of the universe/cosmos

label: Theogony
notes: Narrative explaining the origin, genealogy, and relationships of the gods

label: Anthropogony
notes: Narrative explaining the origin of humanity

label: Etiological Myth
notes: Explains the origin of a natural phenomenon, custom, name, ritual, or object

label: Foundation Myth
notes: Narrative legitimizing the founding of a city, nation, dynasty, social structure, or ritual

label: Hero Saga/Legend
notes: Narrative focusing on the extraordinary deeds of a hero, often with a historical basis or perceived as such

label: Trickster Narrative
notes: Cycle of stories centered on the exploits of a trickster figure

label: Eschatological Myth
notes: Narrative concerning the end of the world, final judgment, or a future paradisiacal age

label: Charter Myth
notes: Narrative that explains or justifies existing social structures, institutions, or beliefs (Malinowski)

label: Divine Myth
notes: Narrative primarily concerning the actions and interactions of gods and goddesses

label: Animal Myth/Fable
notes: Narrative where animals are primary characters, often embodying human traits or teaching morals

label: Hymn/Prayer
notes: Text primarily consisting of hymns, prayers, or invocations to deities

label: Ritual Text
notes: Text designed for ritual performance, funeral rites, or religious ceremony
